### Put Your Foot on It
Author: Jonathan Parnell
Site: Desiring God
URL: https://www.desiringgod.org/articles/put-your-foot-on-it
Passage: Joshua 10:25
Points:
- Joshua had the trapped Amorite kings brought out so his commanders could place their feet on their necks.
- This visible spectacle assured Israel that God would decisively defeat every enemy standing before them.
- The event foreshadows Christ, the promised offspring who crushed humanity's greatest enemy through His cross and resurrection.
- Christians are summoned to step forward and place their feet on sin, deception, and demonic oppression in their daily walk.
- Because Jesus already triumphed, believers can face spiritual warfare with full confidence that sin has lost its dominion.

### Facing the Alliance
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://www.ligonier.org/learn/devotionals/facing-alliance/
Passage: Joshua 10:24
Points:
- After routing the southern coalition, Joshua instructed his captains to place their feet upon the necks of the five captured kings.
- Stepping on a defeated monarch's neck was an ancient symbol of complete subjugation and imminent judgment.
- The kings' vain alliance echoes Psalm 2, demonstrating how foolish human rulers are to conspire against the Almighty.
- Joshua's act points forward to Jesus Christ, who will place every hostile power under His feet.
- Since all people will ultimately bow before Christ, believers must heed the warning to submit to Him willingly today.
